capabilities: Create markdown links from typed Bible references via command or silent mode
Fetch and insert Bible quotes from jw.org with customizable templates
Convert jwpub, publication, and jw.org links to jwlibrary:// links
Link plain-text Bible references in bulk from a selection
Style links and choose Bible book-name language from many locales
extras: Conflicts documented with Iconize (clock emoji when typing ':') and Various Complements (suggestions overwritten); requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; localization details moved to LOCALIZATION.md.
problem: Obsidian cannot turn typed Bible references into links that open in the JW Library app, or pull Bible text into notes.

relations.evidence: creates a markdown link that opens directly in JW Library

summary: JW Library integration that turns Bible references into jwlibrary:// links and fetches scripture text from jw.org into notes.
